This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 10-04-2026 (the "Effective
Date") by and between Atlântico Distribuição SA, with its registered office at Rua Augusta 100,
Lisboa ("Party A"), and Lusitana Ferramentas Lda, with its registered office at Rua Augusta 100,
Lisboa ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 12 months from the Effective Date unless
terminated earlier in accordance with Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall
use it solely for the purposes of this Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Switzerland.

Signatures
